summary.text: THE TAVERN AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2021-12-05. The Tavern AS operates a bar, café and restaurant and participates in related business, including event and concert activities. Its main industry code is 56.110: restaurant activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 15 056 479 NOK and the annual result was 1 521 960 NOK; operating income was down from 18 331 206 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 1 594 273 NOK in 2024 to 1 521 960 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 1 095 132 NOK in 2024 to 1 967 092 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 15 on 2025-11-13 to 13 on 2026-10-14. Recent changes in the register: postal address set to Waldemar Thranes gate 66C on 2026-05-19.
